# orca schedule

Every `orca schedule` command. Ids: a full id, a unique prefix, or (projects) a name or path.

## `orca schedule list [--all]`

this project's schedules: kind, cron, next three slots, last fire and newer-version information

- What it does: reads from the panel (no write).
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `--all`: every project's schedules, not just this one

```
orca schedule list
orca schedule list --all
```

## `orca schedule show <schedule>`

one schedule's body and revision, its next three slots, last fire and newer-version information

- What it does: reads from the panel (no write).
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<schedule>`: a schedule id (orca schedule list)

```
orca schedule show sch-weekly
```

## `orca schedule fires <schedule> [--limit <limit>]`

one schedule's fires, newest first: slot, outcome, reason and what it started

- What it does: reads from the panel (no write).
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<schedule>`: a schedule id (orca schedule list)
- `--limit <n>`: how many fires, newest first (default 50, at most 200)

```
orca schedule fires sch-weekly --limit 10
```

## `orca schedule add flow <template> --cron <cron> [--param <param>] [--clarify <clarify>] [--unattended] [--pool <pool>] [--name <name>] [--disabled] [--id <id>]`

a builtin flow template on a cron (at most hourly), at the version the build ships; needs a person token

- What it does: sends control verb `schedule-set`.
- Who may: a person: needs a person token over the socket (`orca login`, then `--as-person`).
- `<template>`: a builtin template (wechat-article or wechat-article@3)
- `--cron <cron>` (required): 5-field cron (minute hour day month weekday), at most hourly
- `--param <param>` (repeatable): a template param, k=v (repeatable)
- `--clarify <clarify>`: skip: do not ask the template's clarifications
- `--unattended`: start without a person watching
- `--pool <n>`: how much flow-run capacity one fire may take
- `--name <name>`: the schedule's name; default: the template, entry or group
- `--disabled`: create it switched off
- `--id <id>`: the schedule's id; default: sch-<slug of the name>

```
orca schedule add flow wechat-article --cron '0 9 * * 1' --param idea='a topic' --name weekly
```

## `orca schedule add group <entry> --version <version> --cron <cron> [--token-limit <token-limit>] [--name <name>] [--disabled] [--id <id>]`

a plan library entry at one explicit version on a cron; --version is required (orca plan show lists an entry's versions); needs a person token

- What it does: sends control verb `schedule-set`.
- Who may: a person: needs a person token over the socket (`orca login`, then `--as-person`).
- `<entry>`: a plan library entry (pl-…; orca plan list names them)
- `--version <version>` (required): the version's sha256 (orca plan show lists them)
- `--cron <cron>` (required): 5-field cron (minute hour day month weekday), at most hourly
- `--token-limit <n>`: the fired groups' token limit; default: unlimited
- `--name <name>`: the schedule's name; default: the template, entry or group
- `--disabled`: create it switched off
- `--id <id>`: the schedule's id; default: sch-<slug of the name>

```
orca schedule add group pl-0123456789abcdef --version 3f2a… --cron '0 9 * * 1' --name weekly
```

## `orca schedule edit <schedule> [--cron <cron>] [--param <param>] [--name <name>] [--repin <repin>] [--pool <pool>] [--token-limit <token-limit>] [--unlimited]`

change a schedule's cron or name, a flow's params and pool, or a group's pinned version and token limit; needs a person token

- What it does: sends control verb `schedule-set`.
- Who may: a person: needs a person token over the socket (`orca login`, then `--as-person`).
- `<schedule>`: a schedule id (orca schedule list)
- `--cron <cron>`: 5-field cron (minute hour day month weekday), at most hourly
- `--param <param>` (repeatable): a template param, k=v (repeatable)
- `--name <name>`: the schedule's name; default: the template, entry or group
- `--repin <repin>`: a group schedule's new version sha256 (orca plan show lists them)
- `--pool <n>`: how much flow-run capacity one fire may take
- `--token-limit <n>`: the fired groups' token limit; default: unlimited
- `--unlimited`: the group's token limit back to unlimited

```
orca schedule edit sch-weekly --cron '0 10 * * 1'
orca schedule edit sch-weekly --repin 3f2a…
```

## `orca schedule enable <schedule>`

turn a schedule's fires on; needs a person token

- What it does: sends control verb `schedule-enable`.
- Who may: a person: needs a person token over the socket (`orca login`, then `--as-person`).
- `<schedule>`: a schedule id (orca schedule list)

```
orca schedule enable sch-weekly
```

## `orca schedule disable <schedule>`

turn a schedule's fires off (its row and fires stay)

- What it does: sends control verb `schedule-enable`.
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<schedule>`: a schedule id (orca schedule list)

```
orca schedule disable sch-weekly
```

## `orca schedule remove <schedule>`

mark a schedule removed: it never fires again and frees its place in the limit

- What it does: sends control verb `schedule-remove`.
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<schedule>`: a schedule id (orca schedule list)

```
orca schedule remove sch-weekly
```

## `orca schedule resume <schedule>`

resume a schedule paused after repeated failed starts

- What it does: sends control verb `schedule-resume`.
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<schedule>`: a schedule id (orca schedule list)

```
orca schedule resume sch-weekly
```
